subject: Throughput credits addendum + SOW alignment
messages:
From: Emma Chen <emma@brightwave.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-14T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Request: throughput credits addendum + SOW edits

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited about Redwood's latency profile. Before we can finalize procurement, Legal and Product have asked us to add a short addendum to the Order Form and a few clarifications to the SOW:

- Temporary throughput credits: we expect a seasonal peak in Q1 and want to pre-purchase a pool of "burst" throughput credits (one-time addendum) — roughly 50M tokens of burst credits usable over the next 12 months.
- Pricing for overage usage: BrightWave proposes $0.003/token for any usage that exhausts the credit pool during a month.
- SOW clarity: specific API rate limits and a note on expected KV cache persistence for our workload.

I've attached BFW_OrderForm_Redline_v1.docx with highlighted changes from our side. Can Redwood review legal language around the addendum and confirm whether we should proceed with a single addendum or a change order plus SOW amendment? We prefer a clean DocuSign flow but can do countersign if necessary.

Would like to have a path to sign by the end of next week if possible.

Thanks,
Emma Chen
Director, Cloud Partnerships
BrightWave Analytics

Attachment: BFW_OrderForm_Redline_v1.docx (Word doc, 12KB, redline)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Emma Chen <emma@brightwave.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-14T11:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: throughput credits addendum + SOW edits

Emma — thanks for the clear summary and the redline. We're supportive of a simple addendum approach (Order Form addendum + SOW note) rather than a full MSA amendment, which should speed signature.

I've looped in Laura (Legal) and Rishi (Sales lead) to review the proposed pricing tier and the overage carveout. Ben and I will draft a brief internal summary to keep procurement aligned.

Proposed next steps from our side:
- Internal legal review (Laura) — comment on liability, termination, and term language for the addendum.
- Technical clarification on KV cache persistence and rate limits; Ben will scope with our SRE to propose precise SOW wording.
- Share a concise addendum (one page) + SOW paragraph for your review and DocuSign.

I've attached a short internal summary while we review: PRN_internal_redline_summary.pdf. We'll aim to return a proposed addendum by tomorrow EOD PT. If you have a preferred DocuSign template or procurement ID, send it over.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: PRN_internal_redline_summary.pdf (PDF, 6KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-15T08:35:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: throughput credits addendum + SOW edits

Thanks Priya — saw Emma's redline. High-level comments:

1) Structure: I agree an Order Form addendum + SOW paragraph is the lightest-weight path. We should avoid editing the MSA unless BrightWave insists.

2) Pricing language: instead of a flat $0.003/token overage, propose a two-tier overage band to protect Redwood against unexpectedly high sustained overages:
   - Tier A (one-time burst credit usage): $0.003/token up to 100% of the purchased burst pool in any month.
   - Tier B (sustained overage beyond 30 days): $0.005/token.
   Rationale: protects cost while giving the customer runway.

3) Liability and term: add a one-sentence carveout that the addendum does not extend the MSA Term; it only modifies the Order Form for the specified credits. Also confirm renewal treatment of unused credits (recommend: expire at the end of 12 months).

4) Data & KV cache note: ask SRE to confirm whether we can guarantee cache persistence semantics; if not, use "best-effort" language.

5) Signature flow: redline doc should include a countersign style or DocuSign URL. Preference: DocuSign for speed.

I've attached a doc with proposed contract language snippets: RW_Legal_proposed_language.docx. I'm comfortable with Ben and Priya negotiating pricing within the ranges above; if BrightWave pushes back on the Tier B language, escalate to Rishi for approval.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
Attachment: RW_Legal_proposed_language.docx (Word doc, 8KB)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Emma Chen <emma@brightwave.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-15T14:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: throughput credits addendum + SOW edits

Emma — looping back with our consolidated position and next actions.

Summary of what we propose (attached as a 1-page addendum):
- 50,000,000 throughput credits, valid 12 months from signature; unused credits expire.
- Overage pricing: $0.003/token for burst consumption up to the purchased pool in any month; $0.005/token for sustained overages that continue beyond 30 days.
- SOW paragraph: clarify API rate limits (x req/sec) and a "best-effort" KV cache persistence note.
- Addendum does not change MSA Term; it amends the Order Form only.

Next steps:
1) If that language is acceptable, I'll upload the addendum to DocuSign and share the link (preferred).
2) If BrightWave prefers countersign, we can send a signed PDF for your countersignature.
3) Ben — can we confirm internal SRE values for rate limits and add to the SOW paragraph? (Ben: please update and attach.)

Would you be available for a 20-minute call tomorrow at 10am PT to finalize? If yes, I'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0142
Redwood Inference

Attachment: BW_Accepted_Addendum_Signature_Request.pdf (PDF, 4KB)
